## Summary Greenfield build of PinBoard: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres REST API for a single `Pin` entity with full CRUD and validation, served together with an Angular standalone-component SPA wall from one multi-stage Docker image, with no authentication layer. ## Scope ### Files to modify - `README.md` — replace stub with PinBoard name, local dev instructions, env vars, API table. ### Files to create **Root / deployment** - `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: Angular build → Nest build → slim runtime serving both. - `.dockerignore` — exclude `node_modules`, `dist`, `.git`, `.env`. - `docker-entrypoint.sh` — `prisma migrate deploy` → `prisma db seed` → `node dist/src/main.js`. - `docker-compose.yml` — local `postgres:16-alpine` + app service. - `.env.example` — `DATABASE_URL`, `PORT`, `NODE_ENV`. - `.gitignore` — node/Angular/Prisma artifacts. **Backend (`backend/`)** - `package.json` — NestJS 10, Prisma 5, class-validator/transformer; `prisma.seed` hook. - `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.build.json`, `nest-cli.json`. - `prisma/schema.prisma` — `Pin` model, `postgresql` datasource. - `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent upsert of the 3 spec pins. - `src/main.ts` — global `ValidationPipe`, `/api` global prefix (health excluded via explicit paths), CORS for dev, listen on `PORT`. - `src/app.module.ts` — `ConfigModule`, `PrismaModule`, `PinsModule`, `HealthModule`, `ServeStaticModule`. - `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts` — `PrismaClient` + `onModuleInit`. - `src/pins/pins.module.ts`, `src/pins/pins.controller.ts`, `src/pins/pins.service.ts`. - `src/pins/dto/create-pin.dto.ts`, `src/pins/dto/update-pin.dto.ts`. - `src/health/health.module.ts`, `src/health/health.controller.ts`. - `test/pins.e2e-spec.ts`, `src/pins/pins.service.spec.ts`. **Frontend (`frontend/`)** - `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.app.json`, `proxy.conf.json`. - `src/index.html` (`PinBoard`), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.css`. - `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient()`. - `src/app/app.routes.ts` — route table (below). - `src/app/app.component.ts|.html|.css` — shell with `

PinBoard

` header + ``. - `src/app/core/pin.model.ts` — `Pin` interface, `CreatePinDto`, `UpdatePinDto`. - `src/app/core/pins.service.ts` — HTTP client against `/api/pins`, signal-backed pin store. - `src/app/features/wall/wall.component.ts|.html|.css` — pin grid, reads `modal`/`pinId` query params. - `src/app/features/wall/pin-form-dialog.component.ts|.html` — reactive form, create + edit modes. - `src/app/features/wall/confirm-delete-dialog.component.ts|.html`. - `src/app/features/pin-detail/pin-detail.component.ts|.html` — deep-linked single pin, renders 404 state. - `src/app/features/not-found/not-found.component.ts|.html`. ### Dependencies - Backend: `@nestjs/common@^10`, `@nestjs/core@^10`, `@nestjs/platform-express@^10`, `@nestjs/config`, `@nestjs/serve-static@^4`, `express@^4`, `@prisma/client@^5`, `prisma@^5`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `reflect-metadata`, `rxjs`; dev: `@nestjs/cli`, `@nestjs/testing`, `jest`, `ts-jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`, `typescript@~5.4`. - Frontend: `@angular/{core,common,forms,router,platform-browser}@^17`, `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev: `@angular/cli@^17`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular@^17`, `typescript@~5.4`. - Infra: PostgreSQL 16, Docker. ### Integrations (none — no third-party APIs, SDKs, or external services) ### Assumptions - **No auth is implemented.** The spec explicitly states "No auth layer at all" and requires the wall to render with no authentication prompt; the spec is authoritative over the default auth baseline. No login/signup routes, no guards, no user table. - Monorepo layout `backend/` + `frontend/`, single deployed image — chosen because the Colossus workflow defines no image matrix, so one artifact eliminates ambiguity about which frontend is served. - `Pin.id` is a UUID string (`@default(uuid())`); seed rows use fixed UUIDs for idempotent upsert and stable E2E targeting. - Body is optional at the API boundary and defaults to `""`; the seed supplies one-sentence bodies as required. - Title is trimmed before validation, so whitespace-only titles are rejected as empty. - API base path is `/api`; frontend calls same-origin relative URLs (no `environment.ts` API host needed). Dev server uses `proxy.conf.json` → `localhost:3000`. - Angular 17 standalone components + signals, no NgModules, no external UI library — plain CSS grid for the wall. - Modals are query-param addressable rather than child routes, so the wall list stays mounted behind them. - Ordering is `createdAt DESC` with `id DESC` as a deterministic tiebreaker. ## Implementation Plan ### Step 1: Repo scaffolding and env contract **Files:** `.gitignore`, `.env.example`, `docker-compose.yml` **Change:** Define `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://pinboard:pinboard@localhost:5432/pinboard?schema=public`, `PORT=3000`. Compose brings up `postgres:16-alpine` with a named volume and a healthcheck, plus the app service depending on it. ### Step 2: Prisma schema and migration **File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma` **Change:** `datasource db { provider = "postgresql" url = env("DATABASE_URL") }`, `generator client`. Model: ``` model Pin { id String @id @default(uuid()) title String @db.VarChar(120) body String @default("") @db.VarChar(2000) createdAt DateTime @default(now()) updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @@index([createdAt]) } ``` Generate the initial migration into `backend/prisma/migrations/`. ### Step 3: Seed script **File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts` **Change:** `upsert` exactly three pins with fixed UUIDs and explicit staggered `createdAt` (oldest → newest: "Rooftop Garden Plan", "Migration Checklist", "Q3 Roadmap Draft"), each with a one-sentence body. Register via `"prisma": { "seed": "ts-node prisma/seed.ts" }`; compile a JS copy into the image so the entrypoint can run it without ts-node. ### Step 4: Prisma module and bootstrap **Files:** `backend/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `prisma.module.ts`, `backend/src/main.ts`, `backend/src/app.module.ts` **Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. In `main.ts`: `app.setGlobalPrefix('api', { exclude: [] })`, `app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }))`, `app.enableCors()` when `NODE_ENV !== 'production'`, `await app.listen(process.env.PORT ?? 3000, '0.0.0.0')`. ### Step 5: Pin DTOs **Files:** `backend/src/pins/dto/create-pin.dto.ts`, `update-pin.dto.ts` **Change:** `CreatePinDto`: `@Transform(({value}) => typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value) @IsString() @IsNotEmpty() @MaxLength(120) title`; `@IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(2000) body = ''`. `UpdatePinDto extends PartialType(CreatePinDto)`. ### Step 6: Pins service and controller **Files:** `backend/src/pins/pins.service.ts`, `pins.controller.ts`, `pins.module.ts` **Change:** Service methods `findAll()` (`orderBy: [{createdAt:'desc'},{id:'desc'}]`), `findOne(id)` (throw `NotFoundException` when null), `create(dto)`, `update(id, dto)` and `remove(id)` (catch Prisma `P2025` → `NotFoundException`). Controller `@Controller('pins')`: `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /` (`@HttpCode(201)`), `PATCH /:id`, `DELETE /:id` (`@HttpCode(204)`). ### Step 7: Health endpoints **File:** `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts` **Change:** `GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `GET /api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1` via `PrismaService.$queryRaw`, returns `{status:'ok', db:'up'}` or 503. ### Step 8: Static SPA serving **File:** `backend/src/app.module.ts` **Change:** Register `ServeStaticModule.forRoot({ rootPath: join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'public'), exclude: ['/api*'], serveStaticOptions: { fallthrough: true } })` so unknown paths fall back to `index.html` and Angular's client-side routes deep-link correctly. ### Step 9: Angular shell and routes **Files:** `frontend/src/app/app.routes.ts`, `app.component.*`, `app.config.ts`, `src/index.html` **Change:** Shell header renders the literal text `PinBoard` (SMOKE_MARKER) in `app.component.html`. Routes: - `''` → `redirectTo: 'wall'` - `'wall'` → `WallComponent`, `data: { flow: 'wall' }` — reads `?modal=new|edit|delete` and `?pinId=` - `'pins/:id'` → `PinDetailComponent`, `data: { flow: 'pin-detail' }` - `'**'` → `NotFoundComponent`, `data: { flow: 'not-found' }` ### Step 10: Pins data service (frontend) **File:** `frontend/src/app/core/pins.service.ts` **Change:** Injectable with a `signal` store; `load()`, `get(id)`, `create(dto)`, `update(id, dto)`, `remove(id)` against `/api/pins`. Mutations re-sort locally (newest first) so a created pin appears at the top immediately, then refresh from the server. ### Step 11: Wall view **Files:** `frontend/src/app/features/wall/wall.component.*` **Change:** CSS-grid sticky-note cards showing `title` and `body`, newest first. "New pin" button navigates to `?modal=new`; each card has Edit (`?modal=edit&pinId=`), Delete (`?modal=delete&pinId=`), and a title link to `/pins/:id`. Empty and error states included. ### Step 12: Create/edit dialog and delete confirm **Files:** `pin-form-dialog.component.*`, `confirm-delete-dialog.component.*` **Change:** Reactive form: `title` — `Validators.required` + `maxLength(120)`; `body` — `maxLength(2000)`, with live character counters and inline messages mirroring server validation. Submit disabled while invalid; server 400 responses surface field errors. On success/cancel, navigate back to `/wall` (query params cleared). ### Step 13: Pin detail and not-found **Files:** `pin-detail.component.*`, `not-found.component.*` **Change:** Fetch by route `:id`; on a 404 from `GET /api/pins/:id` render a "Pin not found" state with a link back to the wall. This makes the delete-then-fetch-404 scenario visible in the UI. ### Step 14: Dockerfile and entrypoint **Files:** `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`, `.dockerignore` **Change:** Stage 1 `node:20-alpine` — `frontend/` deps + `ng build --configuration production` → `frontend/dist/pinboard/browser`. Stage 2 — `backend/` deps + `prisma generate` + `nest build`. Stage 3 runtime `node:20-alpine`: copy `backend/dist`, `backend/node_modules`, `backend/prisma`, and `COPY --from=frontend /app/frontend/dist/pinboard/browser ./public`. `EXPOSE 3000`, `ENTRYPOINT ["./docker-entrypoint.sh"]`. Entrypoint runs `npx prisma migrate deploy`, then the compiled seed, then `node dist/src/main.js`. ### Step 15: README **File:** `README.md` **Change:** Project name, quickstart (`docker compose up`), local dev (two terminals + proxy), env vars, endpoint table. ## Testing Strategy - **Backend unit** (`pins.service.spec.ts`): ordering is `createdAt DESC`; `findOne`/`remove` on a missing id throw `NotFoundException`. - **Backend e2e** (`pins.e2e-spec.ts`, supertest): `GET /api/pins` returns the 3 seeded titles in newest-first order; `POST` with `{title:''}` → 400 and no row created; `POST` with a 121-char title → 400; valid `POST` → 201 and appears first in the next `GET`; `PATCH` changes the stored text; `DELETE` → 204 and a follow-up `GET /api/pins/:id` → 404. - **Frontend**: `ng build` must succeed; component spec asserting the shell renders the string `PinBoard` and that the wall renders the three seeded titles from a stubbed service. - **Marker verification**: after `docker compose up`, `curl -s localhost:3000 | grep PinBoard` and confirm the wall shows all three seeded titles with bodies. - **Health**: `GET /api/health` → 200; `GET /api/health/deep` → 200 with the DB up, 503 with it stopped. - **Routing**: hard-reload `/wall?modal=new`, `/wall?modal=edit&pinId=`, and `/pins/` — each restores its state; `/pins/` renders not-found. ## Risks - **Static-serve path mismatch** — Angular 17 outputs to `dist/pinboard/browser`, not `dist/pinboard`. A wrong `COPY` yields a blank page and a missing smoke marker. Verify by curling `/` in the built image. - **Express 5 / path-to-regexp v8** breaks `exclude: ['/api*']` in `ServeStaticModule`. Pin `@nestjs/*@^10` and `express@^4`; if the wildcard still fails, register a catch-all controller returning `index.html` instead. - **Migration/seed race on startup** — multiple replicas running `migrate deploy` concurrently. Idempotent `upsert` seeding makes re-runs safe; keep the deployment at one replica initially. - **Public destructive API** — any visitor can delete seeded pins, which would break the acceptance markers on a live instance. Re-seeding restores them; no rate limiting is in scope. - **Colossus build assumptions** — the deploy workflow references no image path, so a root `Dockerfile` at repo root is assumed to be the build target. If the pipeline expects a different location or a service manifest, the Dockerfile path must be adjusted. - **`db.VarChar` vs validator limits** — DB constraints mirror DTO limits; a mismatch surfaces as a 500 instead of a 400. Both are set to 120/2000.
